title: Mandato: Protocol-Level Enforcement of Digitally Signed Mandates on AI Agent Actions with Cryptographically Chained Audit Trails
abstract: arXiv:2608.14074v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents increasingly act on external systems through standardized tool-calling protocols such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP), yet no infrastructure layer constrains their actions to what a principal has verifiably authorized: authorization logic lives in application code, is neither signed nor independently auditable, and the resulting logs lack evidentiary value. We present Mandato, a governance proxy that enforces digitally signed mandates on agent actions at the protocol level. A mandate is a machine-readable, cryptographically signed authorization artifact specifying which tools an agent may invoke, under which parameter constraints and contextual conditions, for how long, and on whose behalf; the proxy evaluates every tool call against the applicable mandate chain, blocks non-conforming calls in line, and records every decision -- permit, deny, and the evidence for each -- in an append-only, hash-chained audit log designed fo

translated_title: Mandato：基于协议层强制执行的数字签名授权机制，用于AI代理操作，并带有密码学链式审计追踪
translated_abstract: AI代理日益通过标准化工具调用协议（如模型上下文协议，MCP）作用于外部系统，然而，目前尚无基础设施层将其操作限制在主体已验证授权的范围内：授权逻辑存在于应用程序代码中，既未签名也无法独立审计，导致生成的日志缺乏证据价值。我们提出Mandato，一种治理代理，在协议层面强制对代理操作执行数字签名授权。授权是一种机器可读、经密码学签名的授权工件，指定代理可以调用哪些工具、受哪些参数约束和上下文条件限制、有效时长及代表谁执行；该代理会针对每项工具调用评估适用的授权链，实时阻止不符合要求的调用，并将每个决策——允许、拒绝及相应证据——记录在仅可追加的、哈希链式审计日志中，该日志专为证据完整性而设计。
tldr: Mandato通过在协议层强制数字签名授权，确保AI代理操作仅限已验证的权限，并提供可审计的哈希链式日志以增强证据价值。
en_tdlr: Mandato enforces digitally signed mandates at the protocol level to constrain AI agent actions to verified permissions, with hash-chained audit logs for evidentiary integrity.
